Package index

Package overview

Overview of the simevent package.

simevent simevent-package
simevent: Simulation and Analysis of Event History Data

Graph-based simulation

Build a simulation spec as a graph of covariates, event processes, and effects between them, and simulate event history data from it.

sim_graph()
Build a Simulation Graph for sim_event_graph()
sim_covariate()
Define a Baseline Covariate for sim_graph()
sim_derived()
Define a Derived Covariate for sim_graph()
sim_process()
Define an Event Process for sim_graph()
sim_effect()
Define an Effect for sim_graph()
sim_event_graph()
Simulate Event History Data from a sim_graph()
sim_graph_from_fits()
Build a sim_graph() from Fitted Cox Models

Treating graph-based simulated data

Functions for formatting, plotting, and summarising data simulated with sim_event_graph().

interval_format_data()
Transform Graph-Based Event Data into Interval Format for Classical Inference
plot_event_data()
Plot Graph-Based Simulated Event History Data
event_risk()
Risk of, or Time Lost to, an Event by a Time Horizon

Core simulation (old)

Functions for simulating event history data, built on the old simEventData/simEventTV engine. Will be removed in the future.

simEventData()
Simulate Continuous Time-to-Event Data with Multiple Event Types
simEventTV()
Simulate Event Data with Time-Varying Effects
simEventDataTdPhi()
Simulate Continuous Time-to-Event Data with Multiple Event Types and time dependent effects
sim.generic()
Simulate Event History Data from a Generic Process Specification

Preset wrappers (old)

Ready-made wrappers for common settings, each hard-coding a fixed baseline/process/effect specification on top of simEventData(). Will be removed in the future.

simSurvData()
Simulate Survival Data with Censoring and Event Times
simCRdata()
Simulate Competing Risks Data
simDisease()
Simulate Data in a Disease Setting
simTreatment()
Simulate Event History Data with Treatment and Time-Dependent Covariate
simDropIn()
Simulate Event Data from a "Drop In" Setting
simStatinData()
Simulate Data in a Statin Setting

Treating simulated data (old)

Functions for formatting and plotting event history data simulated with the old engine. Will be removed in the future.

IntFormatData()
Transform Event Data into Interval Format for Classical Inference
plotEventData()
Plot Simulated Event History Data

Simulating from fitted models (old)

Functions for simulating new data from models fitted to observed data, built on the old engine. Will be removed in the future.

simEventCox()
Simulate Event History Data Based on Cox Models
simEventObj()
Simulate Survival and Competing Risk Data Based on a General Model
sim.from.data()
Simulate Event History Data from Parameters Fitted to Observed Data

Interventions (old)

Functions for performing interventions on the shape parameter of a process, and estimating their effect. Will be removed in the future.

alphaSim()
Simulation and Estimation with Modified Shape Parameter
intEffectAlpha()
Estimate Effect of Intervention: Modifying Eta Parameter of Process
